title: Intrinsic realization preserves the unbounded direct-image scalar mate
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, phi:A -> B a ring homomorphism, and g:Z -> Y any morphism of schemes. On unbounded fixed-scalar pro-etale derived categories let Q_A,Q_B be direct image and T_Z,T_Y derived scalar extension. On intrinsic constant-ring categories let P_A,P_B be direct image and S_Z,S_Y derived scalar extension. Write E for intrinsic realization, r_T:S_T E_A isomorphic to E_B T_T for realizationScalarIso, d_A:P_A E_ZA isomorphic to E_YA Q_A and d_B for the specified direct-image comparison, and alpha:S_Y P_A -> P_B S_Z for the scalar transpose of sfDerivedImageRestriction. Let gamma:T_Y Q_A -> Q_B T_Z be the geometric adjunction mate of scalarPullbackProEtaleIso. For every unbounded fixed-scalar A-complex K, alpha at E_ZA(K), then P_B(r_Z at K), then d_B at T_Z(K), equals S_Y(d_A at K), then r_Y at Q_A(K), then E_YB(gamma at K). There is no site comparison, bounded-below hypothesis, chosen etale origin, or properness hypothesis. The specified realization/scalar comparisons and direct-image restriction square are those of [def-finite-compact-scalar-transport-data] and [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]; the fixed-scalar geometric comparison is that of [def-sp-proetale-scalar-pullback-iso].

proof.text: Form the derived inverse realization/restriction squares and conjugate them forward by the realization equivalences. Apply the restriction/direct-image cube, which is precisely Step 1 of the original plan and has no scalar-extension functor.

Apply realizationScalar_unit to the defining leftAdjointUniq of realizationScalarIso at Z and Y. Apply scalarTranspose_realization_cube to these two unit equations and Step 1. Apply scalarTranspose_inverse_mate with the geometric pullback/direct-image adjunctions; scalarPullbackProEtaleIso is by definition the inverse scalar mate of the restriction square, and fixedScalarRestrictionDirectImage is its inverse geometric mate. This identifies the remaining fixed transpose and gives exactly the original component equation.

lean.statement:
theorem realizationScalar_directImage_mate
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)))) :
    ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Y)).homEquiv _ _).symm
        ((proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g A).map
            ((pbcDerivedScalarAdjunction (scalarRingMap φ Z)).unit.app
              ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z A).functor.obj K)) ≫
          (sfDerivedImageRestriction g φ).hom.app
            ((pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ Z)).obj
              ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Z A).functor.obj K))) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage g B).map
        ((realizationScalarIso φ Z).hom.app K) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g B).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtension (ProEt.topology Z)
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ)).obj K) =
    (pbcDerivedExtend (scalarRingMap φ Y)).map
        ((sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison g A).hom.app K) ≫
      (realizationScalarIso φ Y).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.lowerStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y B).functor.map
        ((mateEquiv
          (ProEtale.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) g)
          (ProEtale.derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) g)
          (TwoSquare.mk _ _ _ _ (ProEtale.scalarPullbackProEtaleIso
            (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) g).hom)).natTrans.app K)
